task.goal: Resend the message I just sent to Juan Alves in Simple SMS Messenger
task.final_summary: I resent your message to Juan Alves in Simple SMS Messenger. The thread now shows a second outgoing copy of "Elementary, my dear Watson." right after the original, and the compose field is empty again. The app's long-press menu on that message offers only Properties, Forward, Select text and Select all, so I resent it by typing the identical text from the original message into the compose field and sending it.

steps.note: Tap the last sent message to open its options menu
Long press the last sent message to open context menu with Resend
Tap More options in the selection bar to find Resend
Dismiss the overflow menu and the selection bar
Tap Done to exit selection mode
Type the identical message text into the compose field
